ability.jaycee.thunderbolt.desc: Zeus's lightning strikes where you look.
ability.jaycee.hermes_dash.desc: A burst of speed in the direction you face.
ability.jaycee.shadow_step.desc: Step through shadow to the block you look at.
ability.jaycee.aegis.desc: Athena's shield: absorption hearts for 15 seconds.
jaycee.message.look_at_block: Look at a block within 24 blocks
jaycee.birthright.mortal_born.subtitle: An ordinary soul. Everything must be earned.
jaycee.birthright.mortal_born.chat: You were born Mortal. The Mist hides the hidden world from you, for now.
jaycee.birthright.oracle_born.subtitle: The Mist is thin around you.
jaycee.birthright.oracle_born.chat: You were born Oracle-born. You will see what others cannot, but it cannot touch you yet.
jaycee.birthright.godblood.subtitle: A god's blood runs in your veins.
jaycee.birthright.godblood.chat: You were born Godblood, the distant child of a god. The hidden world sees you, and it can reach you.
jaycee.prayer.answer: The gods answer your prayer: you carry %s Ichor. You are %s.
